title: The p53-p21-DREAM-CDE/CHR pathway regulates G2/M cell cycle genes

grounded.context: review statement in cultured human and mouse cells
grounded.evidence_quote: The gene of the cyclin-dependent kinase (CDK) inhibitor p21 (WAF1, CIP1, CDKN1A) was the first p53 transcriptional target to be identified and shown to be activated by p53 (3).
